domain cycles (trace-perturbed single rep; read STRUCTURE, not absolute wall) →

FEED-BOUND: the 4 HVX producers run ~78-85% busy on the full HVX solve (DIAG fwd-subst Σ31% + off-diag merge-glue Σ60%); the single HMX consumer is only ~7% busy on the 64³ matmuls (idle ~93%) — opposite balance to pure-HMX, here the HVX producers ARE the work.
